changelog:
- Initial release of ClickUp MCP skill with integration for task, doc, time tracking, comments, chat, and search functionality.
- OAuth authentication required, with setup instructions and workaround for using mcporter.
- Provides 32 tools for comprehensive ClickUp workspace management, covering search, tasks, comments, time tracking, workspace structure, members, chat, and docs.
- Includes detailed setup instructions, usage examples, and documentation links.
- Limitations: no delete operations, no custom fields or view management, OAuth/allowlisted clients only, and standard ClickUp API rate limits.
